text:
erin (PM): quick sync — we need to lock the launch criteria for the cross-region resilience work. customer asks + internal constraints are colliding. can we call out must-haves vs nice-to-haves?

sam (Staff SWE): fwiw: must-haves I'd push: 99.9% p99 latency SLA for primary region, automatic failover within 30s, and deterministic routing policies.

jade (Infra): +1 on failover. also add: encryption-in-transit verified for cross-region traffic and KMS key access patterns documented. private deployments will need HSM notes.

erin (PM): solid. want to also capture migration/rollback criteria — ie how we measure safety during canary. lee, canary gating be KPI-driven?

lee (Eng Mgr): yes — propose these gates: no increase in p99 > 10% from baseline, error-rate spike < 0.1% absolute, and no SLO regressions observed for 2 consecutive hours. if any fails -> automatic rollback.

omar (Solutions): customers will ask about tenancy guarantees. some CCs require strict tenant isolation (no shared KV cache between tenants). need a clear policy: isolation level A/B/C mapping to product tiers.

sam (Staff SWE): isolation mapping makes sense. technical note: strict isolation (A) doubles infra overhead unless we use soft isolation (namespaces + prefixing) + nightly scrub. need cost numbers to present to sales.

jade (Infra): cost numbers: rough calc shows strict isolation across GPU pools -> ~1.9x baseline for small tenants, ~1.3x for large. we can mitigate with bin-packing and tenant affinity windows.

erin (PM): good. let's capture prioritized initiative list: 1) Core SLOs + failover behavior (must), 2) Canary gating + rollback automation (must), 3) Tenant isolation policy + tiers (should), 4) KMS/HSM + compliance docs (should), 5) Cost-optimizations (nice).

lee (Eng Mgr): timeline-wise I can commit to delivering canary automation and gating in Q2 if we scope to only one region pair first. multi-region ramp in Q3.

sam (Staff SWE): routing policies: need programmable policy language for ops to express: prefer-region, hard-affinity, fallthrough->compatible-model. small DSL prototype in a week? can do.

omar (Solutions): customer ask: XCorp requires region-to-region data residency audit trail and role-based routing controls. add to compliance list.

jade (Infra): infra blockers: inter-region bandwidth caps during failover — we need transient scaling plan. propose rate-limiter bypass or burst quota for 60s window.

erin (PM): action items: @sam prototype routing DSL, @lee implement canary gates + automation plan, @jade run cost + bandwidth stress test and KMS checklist, @omar collect top 3 customer isolation asks and examples. I'll draft launch criteria doc from this.

sam (Staff SWE): acked. will post RFC link once DSL sketch is up.

lee (Eng Mgr): ack. I'll attach canary runbook to the RFC.

jade (Infra): adding bandwidth test to infra backlog, will ping infra-oncall for quota.

omar (Solutions): pinging XCorp today, will share specifics.

deploy-bot: Staging canary deployment started for canary-group-23 at sha: a1b2c3 — monitoring enabled :eyes:

erin (PM): thanks team. aim to have a first draft of the launch criteria + gating doc by EOD Friday. if anyone has objections to the priorities above, flag now. :calendar:
